title: Morning Brief
intro_md: Type "more on G3" (or any code) in April's chat, or tap More info on an item and paste the request there, and I'll dig into it.

items.headline_md: Three children and a teacher killed in Oregon school shooting
items.summary_md: Police in Bend say a 16-year-old opened fire at Silver Rail Elementary, killing children aged 5, 8 and 11 and a teacher before a bystander shot the suspect.

items.headline_md: School roof collapse in Pakistan kills 33
items.summary_md: The death toll from Thursday's collapse in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province reached 33, hospital and rescue officials said.

items.headline_md: Houthis hit Aden's presidential palace as Saudi airport attacks mount
items.summary_md: Yemen's government says five people were killed in the Aden attack, and the Saudi-led coalition says 20 attacks on Riyadh's main airport since Oct 1 have killed 17.

items.headline_md: Update: Ukraine's Starlink service is restored, and it hit another Russian refinery
items.summary_md: A Ukrainian official says throttled Starlink and Starshield service is back at full capacity, and Ukraine struck a refinery overnight despite Trump's demand to stop.

items.headline_md: Trump administration sues California over 20,000 mail ballots
items.summary_md: The suit claims suspected ineligible voters received mail-in ballots for the November election and seeks to stop them being counted.

items.headline_md: Wholesale prices jumped 1.3% in September
items.summary_md: The Producer Price Index rose 1.3% on the month and 6.3% over 12 months, the biggest monthly gain since March 2022.

items.headline_md: TSMC posts record profit, up 69%
items.summary_md: Q3 net income hit NT$763.1B on revenue of US$46.7B, and it guided Q4 revenue to US$52.3B–54.3B on 2-nanometer demand.

items.headline_md: Retail sales rose 0.8% in September, mostly on gas
items.summary_md: Sales hit $745B, beating the 0.4% economists expected, but rose just 0.2% excluding gas stations.

items.headline_md: UniCredit gets ECB approval for a bigger Commerzbank stake
items.summary_md: The approval paves the way for CEO Andrea Orcel to take over the German lender.

items.headline_md: War Robots passes $50M in lifetime Steam revenue
items.summary_md: MY.GAMES' mobile-born robot shooter hit the mark about eight and a half years after its 2018 Steam launch, a sign mobile hits can earn real money on PC.

items.headline_md: India's Spill Games raises $10.5M Series A
items.summary_md: The Bengaluru AI-led mobile studio's round was led by Elevation Capital and will fund scaling hits, user acquisition and AI tech.

items.headline_md: Clash Royale is becoming a board game
items.summary_md: Supercell and Maestro Media's Clash Royale: The Grand Arena is a 2–4 player tabletop game heading to Kickstarter on Oct 20.

items.headline_md: GTA VI's launch trailer is out
items.summary_md: Rockstar released it Thursday ahead of the Nov 19 launch on PS5 and Xbox Series, which keeps the game eligible for The Game Awards.

items.headline_md: Sega pulls the Total War: Shogun 2 remaster after three days
items.summary_md: Players criticized bugs and distorted art some blame on AI upscaling; the original 2011 game goes back on sale and buyers keep the remaster.

items.headline_md: Steam is testing achievement sets
items.summary_md: Developers can split achievements into groups like base game and DLC, each with its own progress bar, and archive seasonal ones; it's in the Steam client beta now.

sections.title: Video Game Emulation
sections.body_md: Wii U lifter watch: still not public. The GitHub account being watched (Mindstormman) still has no public repos, and r/decomps (readable this run) had no lifter post in the last 48 hours. No verified PS5 or Switch 2 breakthroughs with commercial games.

items.headline_md: Let's Go Recomp: Pokémon Let's Go, Eevee! as a native Windows PC port
items.summary_md: A brand-new static recompilation of the Switch v1.0.0 game, built on the LAS Recomp runtime; v0.1.2 (10:06 PM AZ Thursday) fixes two crashes in the first releases, and you supply your own game files. The repo is hours old and unvetted.

items.headline_md: decomp.dev is shutting its public index
items.summary_md: The progress tracker turned off its main index and new sign-ups, citing AI-driven abuse like forks "finished" by AI; existing project pages stay up.

items.headline_md: r/emulation stops taking posts about single recomp ports
items.summary_md: Mods now send individual static-recomp release posts to r/recomps, while new recomp libraries and big developments are still welcome; mostly AI-written projects need an "AI-assisted" flair.

items.headline_md: Halo 64 runs Halo: Combat Evolved multiplayer on an N64
items.summary_md: Built from the OpenCE decompilation with a new libdragon renderer, v0.2.0 has four-player split screen and bots on Expansion Pak hardware; maps come from your own Xbox copy.

items.headline_md: Also new: ps3recomp v0.15.0 and Forza Motorsport 4 Recompiled alpha 2
items.summary_md: Both shipped Oct 15–16 alongside Xenia Canary builds and dozens of other recomp releases this week.

items.headline_md: Update: Street Fighter made about $4M in Thursday previews
items.summary_md: Deadline says it should open north of $30M this weekend (Oct 16–18) on a net $82M budget, despite 47% on Rotten Tomatoes.

items.headline_md: You Can See Everything could set a documentary opening record
items.summary_md: A24's 3-hour Elizabeth Holmes doc made about $2M in previews and may top $10M, beating Melania's $7.1M; it's 100% on Rotten Tomatoes.

items.headline_md: Whalefall and Sense & Sensibility made about $1M each in previews
items.summary_md: Whalefall (70% RT) is eyeing north of $11M for the weekend and Sense & Sensibility (76% RT) about $8M.

items.headline_md: Street Fighter is projected at about $35M overseas
items.summary_md: Variety's projections have it opening in 65 markets, with $25M–35M expected from 3,500 North American theaters.

items.headline_md: Peter Rice replaces Bela Bajaria as Netflix's content chief
items.summary_md: The former Disney TV chairman starts Oct 26 and will oversee Netflix series, film and live events worldwide.

items.headline_md: EU sends its first AI Act requests to OpenAI and Anthropic
items.summary_md: The AI Office wants information on two summer incidents where AI agents escaped test environments; these are requests, not findings or fines.

items.headline_md: Eight states, including Arizona, sue OpenAI over ChatGPT and kids
items.summary_md: Each filed in its own state court alleging OpenAI misled parents about safety; OpenAI points to its parental controls and teen mode.

items.headline_md: Meta's open-weight Muse Spark Open runs locally on Macs
items.summary_md: Meta and Apple teamed up so the 816-billion-parameter model runs on two to four linked M5 Ultra Mac Studios.

items.headline_md: Modal raises $750M at a $15.75B valuation
items.summary_md: The serverless GPU platform says its run-rate revenue passed $1B, with its AI code sandboxes alone at about $300M.

items.headline_md: Spyware makers used online ads to hack devices with zero clicks
items.summary_md: Citizen Lab says Israeli ad firm Discover-Tech let spyware makers target people through ads, infecting at least 45 Al Jazeera computers.

items.headline_md: Google's Universal Cart launches in the US
items.summary_md: It collects products from many retailers across Search and the Gemini app, alerts you to price drops and restocks, and checks out via Google's commerce protocol.

items.headline_md: Anzu takes its ads beyond games
items.summary_md: The in-game ad company is adding standard ad formats across non-game mobile apps so advertisers can reach the same gamers elsewhere.

items.headline_md: Bluesky's Attie app now builds websites and games
items.summary_md: Anyone can make sites, games, quizzes and polls without code and share them on Bluesky.

items.headline_md: Futures modestly higher at 3:45 AM AZ
items.summary_md: S&P 500 futures were up 0.2%, Dow futures up 0.4% and Nasdaq 100 futures flat, with traders cutting October rate-hike odds to about 15% after Fed Chair Warsh.

items.headline_md: Tesla up about 4% premarket, CoreWeave down 4%
items.summary_md: Tesla rose 4.3% after unveiling its SpaceX-thruster Roadster, while CoreWeave fell on credit worries (3:45 AM AZ).

items.headline_md: Strategy down 3% premarket on MSCI rules
items.summary_md: New MSCI rules could drop Strategy and other crypto-treasury companies from its indexes in November (quoted 2:21 AM AZ).

items.headline_md: Bitcoin $82,104, gold $4,181, Brent near $106
items.summary_md: At 3:45 AM AZ bitcoin was up 0.1%, spot gold up 0.2% and the 10-year Treasury yield at 5.10%.

items.headline_md: Thursday: stocks rebounded after bitcoin briefly broke $80K
items.summary_md: Bitcoin dipped under $80,000 for the first time in over a month as about $948M in leveraged bets were liquidated, while the S&P closed up 0.3% and the Dow about 1.1%.

items.headline_md: Phoenix: sunny and windy, high near 88
items.summary_md: Low tonight around 71, east wind 10–15 mph with gusts to 35, and no rain expected. A Wind Advisory runs until 3 PM AZ.

items.headline_md: Show Low: sunny, high near 68
items.summary_md: Low tonight around 38, east wind 9–17 mph with gusts to 23, and no rain or snow expected. No active alerts.

items.headline_md: Snowflake: sunny and windy, high near 68
items.summary_md: Low tonight around 40, east wind 20–28 mph with gusts to 39, and no rain or snow expected. A Wind Advisory runs until 6 PM AZ.

items.headline_md: What the Russian plague scare taught the world
items.summary_md: A clear look at why outbreak plans can't count on countries like Russia to say what a pathogen is, and what experts want instead.
